name: Autoscroll
description:
Windows-style middle-click autoscroll in every app.

• Click the middle mouse button, then move the mouse to scroll; the further you move, the faster it goes. Click again to stop
• Or hold the middle button, move, and let go
• Shows the same origin marker and direction arrows as Windows
• Works in browsers, editors, file managers, Electron, Qt and XWayland apps
• Middle-clicking links and browser tabs still works, and terminals keep middle-click paste
